items.question: Which runs does a deploy hold?
options: Every live run with no operator hold
The three statuses the decomposition names
Those three plus a scheduler-wide stop

items.question: What does a press do when there is nothing new to deploy?
options: A refusal in the script under the new flag
The full pipeline and a restart

items.question: What do Pause and Resume do on a run during a deploy?
options: Pause moves the hold to the operator and Resume is refused
Resume converts to a deploy hold

items.header: Who waits for a live step
items.question: Who waits for a live step before the update starts?
options: The controller waits and then starts the unit
The unit starts at once and the script waits in place of its refusal

items.question: What is the top-level money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, and the legal/compliance framing)?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
items.basis: Checked the money, billing, deletion and personal-data surfaces: the spec changes the self-update script, run hold state, two controller routes and two dashboard pages. It handles no payments, credits or user accounts. deploy.json holds run ids, a commit, a timestamp and an error text; removing it on cancel deletes no personal data. The gh credentials in service.env are passed to the unit, never stored in the record.
